title: Impunity creates impunity
content: Even in the fifth year of Russia’s full-scale war on Ukraine, a deep-rooted moral paralysis prevents the Russian opposition from demanding justice for the crimes committed by the state both during Soviet rule and since.

title: Shaken solidarity
content: Jan Patočka’s underground writing on human rights cemented his involvement in Charter 77. But the Czech philosopher’s resistance against communist oppression, written in secret, needed Krzysztof Michalski and his youthful conviction to surface. Tracking the months before Patočka’s post-interrogation death reveals how individual and collective suffering and compassion marked the movement.

title: Fighting erasure
content: How do you write the history of a displaced society when sites of memory have been destroyed, libraries looted, and archives made inaccessible? Tracing the evolution of Palestinian historiography is to analyse responses to this enduring challenge.
